title: Townscaper
description: The web demo of the town-building toy. Click on the open sea and colourful houses, arches, stairways and towers assemble themselves into an island town. There are no goals and no way to lose.
how_to_play: Left-click to add a block and right-click to remove one. Pick a colour from the palette on the left. Stack blocks and build over water to see how the houses connect. The first load takes around 20 seconds.
